scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,dash,wid" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard" "npm run dev -w apps/widget"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/dashboard && npm run build -w apps/widget
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared-types && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/dashboard && npm run typecheck -w apps/widget
